name: seedance-voice-casting
title: Seedance Voice Casting
description: Cast a reusable character voice by generating a short speaking take, then keeping only its audio as a black-frame mp4. Works on both Seedance 2.0 and 2.5; 2.0 fast is the cheap default.

constraints.notes: A voice reference reaches a render as a black-frame .mp4 in video_references, never audio_references.
